hook: A TV special imagined Australia without colonisation, and it aired in 2026.

sections.voiceover: A TV special imagined Australia without colonisation, and it aired in 2026.
sections.visual_cue: Opening shot of the ABC logo fading into the “Address to the Nations” title screen.

sections.voiceover: In 2026 ABC aired “Address to the Nations”, a special by David Pledger and Tony Briggs. What did their 2023 “Tomorrow’s Pasts” launch achieve?
sections.visual_cue: Clip of the 2026 broadcast intro, then portrait of Pledger and Briggs, then a graphic showing the 2023 launch banner with four icons representing the formats.

sections.voiceover: But the four‑format project sparked a national debate on history.
sections.visual_cue: Split‑screen of game, digital art, theatre, and TV clips with news‑headline overlays.

sections.voiceover: The special imagined Australia without colonisation, using game, digital art, theatre and TV. In 2026 it ignited a national debate on rewriting history.
sections.visual_cue: Montage of each format’s scene, overlay of the 2025 residency badge, then newspaper headlines from 2026.

sections.voiceover: A 2026 TV special imagined an uncolonised Australia.
sections.visual_cue: Fade to black with the “Address to the Nations” title lingering.
